source.title: Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization
source.anchor: Unnumbered cumulative-energy display after Lemma4.13 and before Eq.(4.4), printed40/PDF52.

scope: The scaled display is proved for nonnegative D and an arbitrary normed additive commutative group. Specializing to Euclidean feedback and the diameter bound gives the printed estimate. Zero prefixes contribute zero. The causal OSD update, regret statement, equation (4.4) and Theorem 4.14 remain open.
